== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Ashwind is a vast continent characterized by diverse environments, ranging from northern stretches near the [[Trackless Sea]] to southern jungles. Its geography includes deserts, which contribute to its name, and eastern forests that were formerly the domain of [[dragons]]. The continent's heart is located at [[Moongrave]], a central location that holds significant strategic importance. Historically, the land was divided between the [[Blackflame]] organization and Gold dragons{{!}}gold dragons, with the gold and green [[dragons]] currently united under the leadership of [[Seshethkunaaz]]. Ashwind is home to various landmarks, such as the [[Tower of Seven Moons]], a long-standing historical monument and tourist site from the south. The continent is also a site of major conflict, serving as a battlefield where the [[Silent King]] seeks to expand his influence and where various powerful entities, including [[the Queen]] of the Ashwind continent{{!}}Ashwind Continent and [[Malice]], exert their presence.}}
